# webtables/dot

> Field access: `p.f`, a load with the field's offset as the memory offset.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/dot.pkg) · translates [std/dot](../std/dot.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when self size 1`

```nasm
(i64.load8_u offset={f.offset} (i32.wrap_i64
{obj}
))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.load offset={f.offset} (i32.wrap_i64
{obj}
))
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
(i64.add
{obj}
(i64.const {f.offset}))
```
